'''Patitite Pattuna''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] close to the world [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]] that was home to the diminutive [[Patitite/Legends|Patitite]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Description==
[[File:PatititePattunaLandscape-ND.png|thumb|left|220px|The landscape of Patitite Pattuna]]

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] itself, similar to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]], was completely overgrown with fauna and flora. Outside the atmosphere, it was [[Color/Legends|purple]] in color.

==History==
The planet was ruled for many years by a tyrannical dictator named [[Hay-Zu/Legends|Hay-Zu]]. Because he was so feared and so powerful, he was given the nickname "the Big Hay-Zu".

At around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], it was the site of a [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|battle]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ending with a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] victory. [[Hay-Zu/Legends|Hay-Zu]] was also killed, as he was crushed by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], giving praise to the [[Patitite/Legends|Patitites]] and allowing them to start their own democracy.
